def start_from_stat(body, pid):
    # comm can contain spaces and parentheses. The closing delimiter is the last ')'.
    head, separator, rest = body.rpartition(b") ")
    startup_require("stat_delimiter", separator and head.startswith(str(pid).encode() + b" ("))
    fields = rest.split()
    startup_require("stat_state", len(fields) >= 20 and fields[0] not in (b"Z", b"X", b"x"))
    startup_require("stat_start", fields[19].isdigit())
    with startup_scope("stat_start"):
        return integer(int(fields[19]))

def process_status(body, pid, leader=False):
    fields = {}
    for line in body.splitlines():
        key, separator, value = line.partition(b":")
        startup_require("status_fields", separator and key not in fields)
        fields[key] = value.split()
    startup_require("status_pid", fields.get(b"Pid") == [str(pid).encode()])
    wanted = (b"Tgid", b"Uid", b"NSpid")
    startup_require("status_fields", all(key in fields and all(x.isdigit() for x in fields[key]) for key in wanted))
    tgid, uid, nested = (tuple(int(x) for x in fields[key]) for key in wanted)
    startup_require("status_tgid", len(tgid) == 1)
    startup_require("status_uid", len(uid) == 4)
    startup_require("status_nspid", 1 <= len(nested) <= 16)
    startup_require("status_nspid", tgid[0] > 0 and nested[0] == pid and all(x > 0 for x in nested))
    startup_require("status_tgid", not leader or tgid[0] == pid)
    return tgid, uid, nested

def process(self, pid, start, within=None):
    with startup_scope("proc_pidfd"):
        integer(pid, high=(1 << 31) - 1)
        integer(start)
        self.budget.fd()
        pidfd = self.own(os.pidfd_open(pid, 0))
    with startup_scope("proc_dir"):
        directory = self.open(str(pid), self.proc, directory=True)
    with startup_scope("proc_fs"):
        require(fs_magic(directory) == PROC_MAGIC)
    with startup_scope("proc_start"):
        require(start_from_stat(self.read(directory, "stat", 1024), pid) == start)
    with startup_scope("proc_cgroup"):
        membership = cgroup_path(self.read(directory, "cgroup", 1024))
        if within is not None:
            require(len(membership) > len(within.membership))
            require(membership[:len(within.membership)] == within.membership)
    with startup_scope("proc_root"):
        root = self.open("root", directory, directory=True, magic=True)
    with startup_scope("proc_ns"):
        namespaces = tuple(self.open("ns/" + name, directory, magic=True) for name in NS)
    with startup_scope("proc_status"):
        status = process_status(self.read(directory, "status", 4096), pid, leader=True)
    with startup_scope("proc_identity"):
        proc = Process(pid, start, directory, pidfd, root, namespaces, membership,
                       (identity(directory), (identity(root), self.fd_mount_id(root)),
                        tuple(identity(fd) for fd in namespaces)), status)
    with startup_scope("proc_check"):
        self.check_process(proc)
    return proc

def check_process(self, proc):
    self.budget.check()
    with startup_scope("proc_live"):
        require(not select.select([proc.pidfd], [], [], 0)[0])
    with startup_scope("proc_start"):
        require(start_from_stat(self.read(proc.directory, "stat", 1024), proc.pid) == proc.start)
    with startup_scope("proc_cgroup"):
        require(cgroup_path(self.read(proc.directory, "cgroup", 1024)) == proc.membership)
    with startup_scope("proc_status"):
        require(process_status(self.read(proc.directory, "status", 4096), proc.pid, leader=True) == proc.status)
    reopened = []
    try:
        with startup_scope("proc_reopen"):
            reopened.append(self.open(str(proc.pid), self.proc, directory=True))
            reopened.append(self.open("root", reopened[0], directory=True, magic=True))
            reopened.extend(self.open("ns/" + n, reopened[0], magic=True) for n in NS)
        with startup_scope("proc_identity"):
            require((identity(reopened[0]), (identity(reopened[1]), self.fd_mount_id(reopened[1])),
                     tuple(identity(fd) for fd in reopened[2:])) == proc.identity)
    finally:
        with startup_cleanup():
            for fd in reopened:
                self.close_fd(fd)

def status_vectors(body, pid):
    status = boundary.process_status(body, pid, leader=True)
    rows = [line.split()[1:] for line in body.splitlines() if line.startswith(b"NStgid:")]
    boundary.startup_require("status_nstgid", len(rows) == 1 and rows[0] and all(x.isdigit() for x in rows[0]))
    groups = tuple(int(x) for x in rows[0])
    boundary.startup_require("status_nstgid", groups == status[2])  # leader, in every represented namespace
    return status, groups

def process(self, pid, start, within=None):
    process = super().process(pid, start, within)
    with boundary.startup_scope("proc_timens"):
        time_namespace = self.open("ns/time", process.directory, magic=True)
        require(boundary.identity(time_namespace) == boundary.identity(self.reader_time_namespace))
    with boundary.startup_scope("proc_live"):
        live(process.pidfd)
    if not hasattr(self, "process_times"):
        self.process_times = {}
    self.process_times[process] = time_namespace
    return process

def check_process(self, process):
    super().check_process(process)
    time_namespace = getattr(self, "process_times", {}).get(process)
    if time_namespace is not None:
        with boundary.startup_scope("proc_timens"):
            reopened = self.open("ns/time", process.directory, magic=True)
        try:
            with boundary.startup_scope("proc_timens"):
                require(boundary.identity(reopened) == boundary.identity(time_namespace)
                        == boundary.identity(self.reader_time_namespace))
        finally:
            with boundary.startup_cleanup():
                self.close_fd(reopened)

scripts/native_pids_locator.py:LocatorSo.source:
def namespace_chain(self, active, vector):
    """Return actual R..active object identities, retaining every parent FD."""
    chain = [active]
    target = boundary.identity(self.reader_namespace)
    while boundary.identity(chain[-1]) != target:
        require(len(chain) < 16)
        self.budget.fd()
        try:
            parent = fcntl.ioctl(chain[-1], NS_GET_PARENT)
        except OSError:
            raise LocatorRefusal("NamespaceUnreachable") from None
        self.own(parent)
        os.set_inheritable(parent, False)
        require(boundary.identity(parent) not in tuple(boundary.identity(fd) for fd in chain))
        chain.append(parent)
    identities = tuple(boundary.identity(fd) for fd in reversed(chain))
    require(len(identities) == len(vector))
    return identities

def locate_batch(self, slots):
    transfer = None
    stage = "input"
    try:
        require(not self.failed and not self.sealed and not self.bound and type(slots) is dict
                and tuple(slots) == ORDER and len(set(slots.values())) == 6)
        stage = "inspect"
        before = {slot: self.inspect(cid) for slot, cid in slots.items()}
        if self.slot_label is not None:
            require(all(dict(before[slot][3]).get(self.slot_label) == slot for slot in ORDER))
        stage = "namespace"
        daemon_ns = boundary.identity(self.daemon.namespaces[0])
        stage = "module"
        discovery = _discovery_module()
        stage = "epoch"
        self.source.type_scope().begin_locate()
        matched = set()
        def consume(lease):
            for record in lease.candidates:
                with lease.acquire(record) as candidate:
                    chain, vector = candidate.namespace_chain, candidate.status[2]
                    if daemon_ns not in chain:
                        continue
                    index = chain.index(daemon_ns)
                    for slot in ORDER:
                        if vector[index] == before[slot][0]:
                            require(index < len(chain) - 1 and vector[-1] == 1)
                            if slot in matched:
                                raise LocatorRefusal("AmbiguousMatch")
                            matched.add(slot)
                            lease.select(discovery.Role(slot), candidate)
            if matched != set(ORDER):
                raise LocatorRefusal("NoMatch")
        def discovery_failure(site):
            nonlocal stage
            if type(site) is str and site in LOCATE_STAGES:
                stage = next(value for value in LOCATE_STAGES if value == site)
        stage = "discovery"
        transfer = discovery.discover(self.source, self.outer_group, discovery.Mode.WORKERS, consume,
                                      failure_site=discovery_failure)
        stage = "membership"
        self.source.adopt_discovery_types(transfer, self.outer_group)
        observed_identities = {row.identity[:2]: row.identity for row in transfer.types}
        result = {}
        for selected in transfer.selections:
            slot = selected.role.value
            candidate = selected.candidate
            process, chain = candidate.process, candidate.namespace_chain
            group = self.source.group(process)  # complete traversal already closed
            self.source.descendant(self.outer_group, group)
            self.source.leaf(group)
            expected = "max" if slot.endswith("unlimited") else (16 if slot.endswith("16") else 64)
            maximum, current, _events = self.source.values(group)
            require(maximum == expected and current == 1)
            _root, nodes = self.source.controller_groups[group.identities[-1]]
            require(nodes[0][1] == observed_identities[selected.local_witness.identity]
                    and group.membership == selected.local_witness.membership == process.membership)
            coverage = [node for node in nodes if node[1][:2] == selected.coverage_witness.identity]
            require(len(coverage) == 1 and coverage[0][1] == observed_identities[selected.coverage_witness.identity])
            result[slot] = RuntimeBoundProcess(slot, slots[slot], process, group, chain, before[slot])
        stage = "distinctness"
        require(len({x.process.pid for x in result.values()}) == 6
                and len({x.group.identities[-1] for x in result.values()}) == 6)
        stage = "recheck"
        for slot, item in result.items():
            require(self.inspect(item.container_id) == item.inspect_facts)
            self.source.check_process(item.process)
            self.source.check_group(item.group)
        self.check_daemon()
        stage = "freeze"
        self.source.freeze_measurement_types(item.group for item in result.values())
        stage = "transfer"
        transfer.release_witnesses()
        transfer.handoff()
        self.bound = result
        return result  # live Python objects directly to collector, never JSON
    except LocatorRefusal as error:
        _locate_failure(stage, error)
        self.failed = True
        if transfer is not None:
            transfer.abort()
        raise
    except (Exception, KeyboardInterrupt) as error:
        _locate_failure(stage, error)
        self.failed = True
        if transfer is not None:
            transfer.abort()
        raise LocatorRefusal() from None

def _discover(source, outer, mode, consume, progress):
    """Run one bounded lease; matching callback receives only this local lease.

    No caller path/PID/FD list, source-provider selection or serialized authority
    is accepted. Source/outer/callback are fixed trusted integration objects.
    Outer authenticity/current/limit and final ROOT acceptance remain caller
    duties. Work/cleanup failures never return a partially populated transfer.
    """
    require(type(mode) is Mode and callable(consume))
    baseline = frozenset(source.owned)
    cleanup = _Cleanup(source, baseline)
    lease = None
    root = outer.directories[-1]
    nodes, identities = [], set()

    def metadata(fd):
        require(boundary.fs_magic(fd) == boundary.CGROUP_MAGIC)
        return boundary.identity(fd), source.fd_mount_id(fd)

    def read_cgroup(fd, name, cap):
        file = source.open(name, fd)
        try:
            require(boundary.fs_magic(file) == boundary.CGROUP_MAGIC)
            return source.read_fd(file, cap)
        finally:
            cleanup.close_fd(file)

    def typed_procs(fd, parent=None, initial=False):
        kind = topology.parse_type(read_cgroup(fd, "cgroup.type", 32))
        if initial:
            topology.coverage_plan(tuple(topology.Node(index, node.parent, node.kind)
                                         for index, node in enumerate(nodes))
                                   + (topology.Node(len(nodes), parent, kind),), 0)
        pids = ()
        if kind is not topology.CgroupType.THREADED:
            body = read_cgroup(fd, "cgroup.procs", 5632)
            require(not body or re.fullmatch(rb"(?:[1-9][0-9]{0,9}\n)+", body) is not None)
            values = tuple(int(pid) for pid in body.splitlines())
            require(len(values) == len(set(values)) and all(pid < 2**31 for pid in values))
            pids = tuple(sorted(values))
            require(topology.parse_type(read_cgroup(fd, "cgroup.type", 32)) is kind)
        return kind, pids

    def entries(fd):
        result = source.entries(fd)
        require(type(result) is tuple and len(result) <= 4096)
        for name, kind in result:
            require(type(name) is str and name and name.isascii() and "/" not in name
                    and "\0" not in name and name not in (".", "..") and kind in (4, 8))
        require(len({name for name, _kind in result}) == len(result))
        return tuple(sorted(result))

    def walk(fd, parent, membership, depth):
        require(depth <= topology.MAX_DEPTH and len(nodes) < topology.MAX_NODES)
        identity, mount = metadata(fd)
        require(identity[0] == root_identity[0] and mount == root_mount and identity not in identities)
        identities.add(identity)
        listing = entries(fd)
        kind, pids = typed_procs(fd, parent, initial=True)
        index = len(nodes)
        nodes.append(_Node(fd, parent, membership, identity, listing, kind, pids))
        for name, entry_kind in listing:
            if entry_kind == 4:
                require(depth < topology.MAX_DEPTH and len(nodes) < topology.MAX_NODES)
                walk(source.open(name, fd, directory=True), index, membership + (name,), depth + 1)

    def provisional(pid, coverage):
        previous = frozenset(source.owned)
        try:
            directory = source.open(str(pid), source.proc, directory=True)
            require(boundary.fs_magic(directory) == boundary.PROC_MAGIC)
            identity = boundary.identity(directory)
            start = boundary.start_from_stat(source.read(directory, "stat", 1024), pid)
            membership = boundary.cgroup_path(source.read(directory, "cgroup", 1024))
            require(boundary.start_from_stat(source.read(directory, "stat", 1024), pid) == start)
            require(membership in by_membership)
            local = by_membership[membership]
            require(plan[local].owner == coverage)
            return Provisional(pid, start, identity, membership, local, coverage)
        finally:
            cleanup.release(previous)

    try:
        require(root in baseline and source.proc in baseline)
        require(boundary.fs_magic(source.proc) == boundary.PROC_MAGIC)
        proc_identity = boundary.identity(source.proc)
        root_identity, root_mount = metadata(root)
        walk(root, None, outer.membership, 0)
        progress[0] = "disccoverage"
        plan = {step.node: step for step in topology.coverage_plan(
            tuple(topology.Node(index, node.parent, node.kind) for index, node in enumerate(nodes)), 0)}
        by_membership = {node.membership: index for index, node in enumerate(nodes)}
        leaders = {}
        for index, node in enumerate(nodes):
            for pid in node.pids:
                require(pid not in leaders and len(leaders) < 512)
                leaders[pid] = index
        progress[0] = "discrecords"
        records = tuple(provisional(pid, leaders[pid]) for pid in sorted(leaders))
        require(len({record.directory_identity for record in records}) == len(records))
        lease = _Lease(source, mode, records, cleanup)
        progress[0] = "discmatch"
        consume(lease)
        selected = lease.finish()
        progress[0] = "discrecheck"
        # Pass B: complete held graph, named objects, coverage and local records.
        require(boundary.fs_magic(source.proc) == boundary.PROC_MAGIC
                and boundary.identity(source.proc) == proc_identity)
        for node in nodes:
            require(metadata(node.directory) == (node.identity, root_mount)
                    and entries(node.directory) == node.entries
                    and typed_procs(node.directory) == (node.kind, node.pids))
            if node.parent is not None:
                reopened = source.open(node.membership[-1], nodes[node.parent].directory, directory=True)
                try:
                    require(metadata(reopened) == (node.identity, root_mount))
                finally:
                    cleanup.close_fd(reopened)
        require(tuple(provisional(record.pid, record.coverage) for record in records) == records)
        for _role, candidate, _scope in selected:
            source.check_process(candidate.process)
            require(boundary.identity(candidate.process.directory) == candidate.provisional.directory_identity
                    and candidate.process.membership == candidate.provisional.membership)
        require(boundary.fs_magic(source.proc) == boundary.PROC_MAGIC
                and boundary.identity(source.proc) == proc_identity
                and metadata(root) == (root_identity, root_mount))
        witness_indices = sorted({index for _role, candidate, _scope in selected
                                 for index in (candidate.provisional.local, candidate.provisional.coverage)})
        witnesses = {index: Witness(nodes[index].directory, nodes[index].identity, nodes[index].membership,
                                    nodes[index].directory in baseline) for index in witness_indices}
        selections = tuple(Selection(role, candidate, witnesses[candidate.provisional.local],
                                     witnesses[candidate.provisional.coverage])
                           for role, candidate, _scope in selected)
        process_owned = set().union(*(scope for _role, _candidate, scope in selected))
        witness_owned = {witness.directory for witness in witnesses.values() if not witness.borrowed}
    except BaseException:
        failed_site = progress[0]
        progress[0] = "discrelease"
        if lease is not None:
            # A malformed trusted caller may abandon an acquisition context.
            # Retire it before ROOT cleanup so delayed generator finalization
            # cannot close later Source scopes from a stale ownership snapshot.
            lease._retired = True
        cleanup.release(baseline)
        progress[0] = failed_site
        raise
    types = tuple(TypeObservation((*node.identity, root_mount),
                                 (*nodes[node.parent].identity, root_mount) if node.parent is not None else None,
                                 node.kind) for node in nodes)
    progress[0] = "discrelease"
    cleanup.release(baseline | process_owned | witness_owned)
    return DiscoveryTransfer(source, selections, tuple(witnesses.values()), process_owned, witness_owned, types)

@contextmanager
def acquire(self, record):
    require(not self._retired and self._active is None and _state(self.source) == self._expected)
    require(any(record is candidate for candidate in self.candidates) and record.pid not in self._seen)
    self._seen.add(record.pid)
    previous = frozenset(self.source.owned)
    retained = False
    try:
        process = self.source.process(record.pid, record.start)
        require(type(process) is boundary.Process
                and process.pid == record.pid and process.start == record.start
                and boundary.identity(process.directory) == record.directory_identity
                and process.identity[0] == record.directory_identity
                and process.membership == record.membership)
        status, vector = locator.status_vectors(self.source.read(process.directory, "status", 4096), record.pid)
        require(status == process.status)
        chain = self.source.namespace_chain(process.namespaces[0], vector)
        # Capture the complete virtual Source.process + namespace_chain delta,
        # including LocatorSource.process_times and every retained parent FD.
        scope = frozenset(self.source.owned - previous)
        require(process.directory in scope)
        candidate = Candidate(process, status, chain, record)
        self._active, self._chosen = candidate, None
        before_callback = _state(self.source)
        yield candidate
        require(not self._retired and _state(self.source) == before_callback)
        if self._chosen is not None:
            self._selected[self._chosen] = (candidate, scope)
            retained = True
    finally:
        self._active, self._chosen = None, None
        if not retained and not self._retired:
            self.cleanup.release(previous)
        self._expected = _state(self.source)

def select(self, role, candidate):
    roles = (Role.PEER,) if self.mode is Mode.PEER else tuple(role for role in Role if role is not Role.PEER)
    require(not self._retired and self._active is not None
            and type(role) is Role and role in roles and role not in self._selected
            and self._chosen is None and candidate is self._active)
    self._chosen = role
